title: Nest calls with parentheses
objective: Put a call inside another call with parentheses, and know that arithmetic inside a value is worked out before the call receives it.

body.text: Each value in a call can be a sum or a product, such as 5 plus 1 or 2 times 3. The arithmetic is worked out first, and the result is the value. So add 4 and 5 plus 1 passes 4 and 6, and the answer is 10.

body.title: Arithmetic inside a value
body.code:
function add
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left plus right

say add 4 and 5 plus 1
say add 2 times 3 and 4

body.text: A value can also be another call. Put the inner call in parentheses, so the compiler knows where its values end and which call they belong to. Without the parentheses, the values run on into the outer call and the compiler reports an error.

body.title: A call inside parentheses
body.code:
function add
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left plus right

function double
    takes number called n
    gives back n times 2

say add (double 3) and 4
make total equal to add 2 and 3
say total

body.prompt: The program does not compile: the parser cannot tell where the nested call ends. Make it print 10.
body.starter:
function add
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left plus right

function double
    takes number called n
    gives back n times 2

say add double 3 and 4
body.solution:
function add
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left plus right

function double
    takes number called n
    gives back n times 2

say add (double 3) and 4
